Appendix K was approved in Fall 2018 and our original accelerated BS/MS program (Bill_17-18-35B) does not allow students to double count any credits. Landscape architecture is a profession that involves the design, planning, preservation, and restoration of the landscape by applying art, science, and technology to achieve the best use of our land and water resources.
Landscape architects design and plan parks, plazas, and recreation areas; residential, institutional and commercial developments; transportation facilities, new towns and campus landscapes, and green infrastructure.
